source: Seeded by querying https://api.osv.dev/v1/query (package+ecosystem, no auth needed) for each listed package and taking a well-established, high/critical-severity advisory — verified against OSV at generation time, not hand-guessed. This is offline data for vandam's free-tier local Supply Chain detection (an approximate, periodically-refreshed cross-check covering one notable advisory per package, not an exhaustive feed) — vandam-pro's subscriber-only OSV.dev cloud lookup queries live and returns every known advisory. Refresh via protect-community/scripts/update_known_vulnerable_packages.sh. ecosystem values match OSV.dev naming so vandam-pro's OSV lookup and this file describe the same package identity. vulnerable_ranges use OSV's own event semantics (introduced/fixed), expressed here as a simple '<fixed_version' string per range since this file only needs a fast local semver check, not OSV's full range model.

packages.name: lodash
packages.summary: Prototype pollution via defaultsDeep allows arbitrary property injection.

packages.name: minimist
packages.summary: Prototype pollution via crafted constructor/proto argument parsing.

packages.name: node-fetch
packages.summary: Forwards secure headers (e.g. Authorization) to untrusted redirect targets, leaking credentials.

packages.name: axios
packages.summary: Denial of service via unbounded response content-length allowing memory/disk exhaustion.

packages.name: ua-parser-js
packages.summary: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via a crafted User-Agent string.

packages.name: django
packages.summary: SQL injection via QuerySet.annotate()/aggregate()/extra() column aliases.

packages.name: pyyaml
packages.summary: Arbitrary code execution via full_load()/FullLoader when parsing attacker-controlled YAML.

packages.name: urllib3
packages.summary: Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor via cross-host redirect header retention.

packages.name: requests
packages.summary: Authorization header persists across cross-domain redirects, leaking credentials to a third-party host.

packages.name: pillow
packages.summary: Arbitrary code execution via crafted PIL.ImageMath.eval() environment.

packages.name: phpunit/phpunit
packages.summary: eval-stdin.php util script allows remote code execution when publicly reachable — widely mass-exploited by botnets.

packages.name: laravel/framework
packages.summary: Deserialization vulnerability in the framework's Illuminate component allows remote code execution.

packages.name: symfony/http-kernel
packages.summary: Remote code execution when the profiler/debug toolbar is reachable with a predictable token.

packages.name: rack
packages.summary: Shell escape sequence injection allows terminal-based attacks against operators viewing logs.

packages.name: actionpack
packages.summary: Remote code execution via unrestricted use of the render method with attacker-influenced input.

packages.name: time
packages.summary: Unsound reading of localtime_r environment data can cause a segfault under concurrent access.

packages.name: openssl
packages.summary: X.509 certificate punycode buffer overflow in name-constraint checking.

packages.name: xz-utils
packages.summary: Backdoored liblzma build script injects malicious code into linked sshd, enabling remote code execution.
